title: Triage of Abdominal Pain in the Emergency Department
brief_summary: The investigators aim to evaluate in a retrospective study the performance of the Swiss Emergency Triage Scale to identify at the door of the Emergency Department patients requiring emergent intervention.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* \>= 16 y
* abdominal pain as the main complaint

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
study_population: Adults (\> 16 y) admitted with abdominal pain in the Emergency Departement of a primary and tertiary teaching urban hospital.
